check:
사용법: kit_life.sh routine add|list|show|update|pause|resume|retire|exception|insist|health|materialize ...
  add <title> <cadence> [field=value ...] [--new]
      cadence: D | W:MON,WED,FRI | I:2@YYYY-MM-DD
               | M:12 (monthly; M:1,15 / M:L last day)
               | MW:2:MON (Nth weekday of the month, N=1..4|L)
               | Y:03-05 (yearly, solar) | YL:08-15 (yearly, lunar)
               | IM:3@YYYY-MM-DD (every N months)
      cadence-label <cadence>  -> the owner-facing label
      field: time(HH:MM) duration area project purpose start end
             until(event|date|+Nd|+Nw|+Nm|open) open(1) ask(1)
             (project accepts id OR title, same resolve as
             task-add/appt-add --project -- _resolve_project_id)
             notify(default|silent|start_only|<lead-min>)
             kind(task|presence) action(check|workout|retro|session|other)
             place(<name>, presence requires it)
             ride(travel|off) fallback(HH:MM | MON,FRI=HH:MM;HH:MM)
             not_before(HH:MM) prefer(morning|evening)
             alternatives(JSON: alternatives, optional priority/fallback_at)
             -- ride=travel: rides the day's first move leg that
             fits duration, else sits at fallback (070)
  update <def_ulid> [effective_from=YYYY-MM-DD] field=value ...
      field: also place(<name|id>, empty clears) -- future rows
             take the place, travel/prep follow (past untouched)
  insist <def_ulid> date=YYYY-MM-DD time=HH:MM (owner override)
  exception <event_ulid> field=value ... (field: start_at end_at date title note)
  health [window=N] [as_of=YYYY-MM-DD]

사용법: kit_life.sh routine add|list|show|update|pause|resume|retire|exception|insist|health|materialize ...
  add <title> <cadence> [field=value ...] [--new]
      cadence: D | W:MON,WED,FRI | I:2@YYYY-MM-DD
               | M:12 (monthly; M:1,15 / M:L last day)
               | MW:2:MON (Nth weekday of the month, N=1..4|L)
               | Y:03-05 (yearly, solar) | YL:08-15 (yearly, lunar)
               | IM:3@YYYY-MM-DD (every N months)
      cadence-label <cadence>  -> the owner-facing label
      field: time(HH:MM) duration area project purpose start end
             until(event|date|+Nd|+Nw|+Nm|open) open(1) ask(1)
             (project accepts id OR title, same resolve as
             task-add/appt-add --project -- _resolve_project_id)
             notify(default|silent|start_only|<lead-min>)
             kind(task|presence) action(check|workout|retro|session|other)
             place(<name>, presence requires it)
             ride(travel|off) fallback(HH:MM | MON,FRI=HH:MM;HH:MM)
             not_before(HH:MM) prefer(morning|evening)
             alternatives(JSON: alternatives, optional priority/fallback_at)
             -- ride=travel: rides the day's first move leg that
             fits duration, else sits at fallback (070)
  update <def_ulid> [effective_from=YYYY-MM-DD] field=value ...
      field: also place(<name|id>, empty clears) -- future rows
             take the place, travel/prep follow (past untouched)
  insist <def_ulid> date=YYYY-MM-DD time=HH:MM (owner override)
  exception <event_ulid> field=value ... (field: start_at end_at date title note)
  health [window=N] [as_of=YYYY-MM-DD]

workout-del:
사용법: kit_life.sh workout-del <id> [--confirm-destroy-sets <n>]
  세션 삭제는 그 세션의 workout_sets 전부를 CASCADE로 같이 지운다.
  <n> 없이 부르면 지워질 대상(세트 수/종목명/날짜)만 출력하고 거부한다.
  세트 1개만 지우려면 files/program/set-undo,
  종목 1개는 files/program/exercise-drop,
  세션 폐기는 files/program/session-abort 를 쓸 것.
workout-upd:
사용법: kit_life.sh workout-upd <id> field=value [field=value ...]
  field: date minutes kcal note avg_hr kcal_origin
  kcal= (빈 값) = 미기록으로 되돌림(출처도 지워짐). kcal 을 바꾸며
  kcal_origin 을 안 주면 새 숫자의 출처는 unknown.
  지정한 필드만 바뀐다(부분 수정). 분류/session_type은 이 명령으로 안 바뀜.
